about: What the smoke test runs, where each input officially comes from and what it is checked against. acquire.sh reads this file; the extension and npm pins it checks are the ones the tested skill itself carries in skills/chrome_browser/pins.json.

hub.commit_subject: Let a Chrome screenshot name its tab without selecting it
hub.check: git fetches the commit by its full SHA; the git tree of skills/chrome_browser must equal skill_tree (otherwise acquire.sh stops before fetching anything else); SKILL.md must say skill_version

chrome_for_testing.check: the official listing names this archive for this version and platform; size and md5 equal Google's storage metadata (Google publishes no sha256: it is computed and recorded)

extension.name: Playwright Extension
extension.check: sha256 equals pins.json extension.tested_build.crx_sha256 of the tested skill; the signed crx_id and the manifest key both give the id; manifest.json, lib/background.mjs and lib/ui/connect.js equal the pinned hashes; the CRX3 signatures are checked with openssl and recorded. The Web Store serves only its newest build: if it is not the pinned one, acquire.sh stops (exit 3). The unpacked copy leaves out _metadata/, which Chrome refuses in an unpacked extension.

npm.source: the registry tarball URLs in pins.json of the tested skill
npm.check: sha512 integrity and sha1 shasum equal pins.json; files are unpacked without npm and without install scripts; the pinned file hashes are checked here and again by the skill when it starts

runner.kind: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-22.04 (acquire.sh and run.sh refuse elsewhere: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=github-hosted)
runner.packages_source: the Ubuntu archive, installed by the workflow with apt-get
runner.prerequisites: unprivileged user namespaces for Chrome's own sandbox, Chrome's system libraries; where one is missing the run ends UNVERIFIED and nothing on the system is changed
